name: Kojiro with the paper surface upgrade (test, 27 Nov)
note: TEST for Mark's paper-upgrade comparison: the same parts as kojiro-ai2; every fold sharper than 28 deg measured into the mesh, ink 3.5 mm wide in the valleys, a light edge on the ridges, a printed mottle, soft occlusion in the folds (paper_materials.paper_surface). Production Kojiro is unchanged. v2: the light edge is each paper's own colour lifted (not a fixed white), folds sharper than 36 deg only, ink 0.85, 3 mm.
